The bookshop client wanted something calm and wise, with no owls and no cat. Leo suggested an elephant, but Maya, Tom and Priya leaned toward a fox, tied to the owner's favourite book. Tom proposed a curled-up fox until Priya warned that it "could turn into a fuzzy blob once it falls." Leo sketched a sitting fox instead, with sharp ears, a long snout and a tail swept out to the side, and the team agreed.

Maya took the tail. Priya drew the back, ears and head down to the nose. Leo checked the junctions, then laid the jaw from the nose tip to the chest. Maya confirmed the whole chain was clean and said, "Hands off from here, everyone."

When the timer ran out, the start domino fell. All 84 fell.
